raptor.label: Raptor (starter)
raptor.note: The starter monster: no element or status. Name a part spikes* and its tail spin would poison, so don't. Top-down, facing RIGHT (+x); its left side is up. A part's pivot is its joint. HIT AREAS = the shapes: a part's SECTION is its hit zone (Head, Body, Legs, Tail; anything else counts as Body). Give a part a <name>@broken version and its zone can be broken (the game swaps it in): frill@broken = head broken (weaker side bites), leg@broken = legs broken (shorter jumps). The tail is cut off at tail3: everything from there down falls off. The game moves: legs step, tail1..tail6 + tail_tip lie along the swinging tail, it squashes, stretches and grows in the air when it jumps. eyes@rage shows while enraged. Black 'cut' holes are looks only (they don't change the hit area).

spiketail.label: Spiketail
spiketail.note: Top-down, facing RIGHT (+x); its left side is up. A part's pivot is its joint. HIT AREAS = the shapes: a part's SECTION is its hit zone (Head, Body, Legs, Tail; anything else counts as Body). Give a part a <name>@broken version and its zone can be broken (the game swaps it in): frill@broken = head broken (weaker side bites), leg@broken = legs broken (shorter jumps). The tail is cut off at tail3: everything from there down falls off. While any part named spikes* is still on, the tail spin poisons. The game moves: legs step, tail1..tail6 + tail_tip lie along the swinging tail, it squashes, stretches and grows in the air when it jumps. eyes@rage shows while enraged. Black 'cut' holes are looks only (they don't change the hit area).

thornwing.label: Thornwing
thornwing.note: The big winged one. Top-down, facing RIGHT (+x); its left side is up. A part's pivot is its joint. HIT AREAS = the shapes: a part's SECTION is its hit zone (Head, Body, Wings, Legs, Tail; anything else counts as Body). Give a part a <name>@broken version and its zone can be broken (the game swaps it in): crest@broken = head broken (weaker bites), wing_l@broken / wing_r@broken = wings broken (shorter charges). The tail is cut off at tail3: everything from there down falls off. While any part named spikes* is still on, the tail flip poisons. The game moves: legs step, wing_l / wing_r spread about their shoulders, tail1..tail6 + tail_tip lie along the swinging tail, it squashes, stretches and somersaults (squashed flat, then turned round) when it flips. eyes@rage shows while enraged. Black 'cut' holes are looks only (they don't change the hit area). Hunters can stand under every part but the Legs.

hunter.label: Hunter
hunter.note: Top-down, facing RIGHT (+x). Teal (#6fb7a8) is repainted to each hunter's own colour. The body's size is the hunter's size in the game. The sword (a longsword) is one part on two nodes: 'sword' in the hand (its pivot is the hand; the game swings it about that, and the BLADE'S SHAPES ARE WHAT HITS) and 'sword_back' (on the back, shown while it's put away).
